about: Frozen routing test set, written on 2026-10-04 BEFORE any router code existed. Each question is labelled with the domain whose documents should answer it: 'rti', 'agriculture', or 'other' (outside both, e.g. ration cards, budgets, passports -- finance is not built yet, so finance questions are 'other' for now). 'also_ok' lists other answers that are acceptable for a genuinely two-sided question. The label is about the TOPIC, not whether the documents happen to contain the answer. 'plain' is ordinary casual questions; 'traps' are questions whose words point to the wrong domain (an RTI request about a farm scheme; a farm question that says 'appeal', 'information', 'right' or 'penalty'); 'other' is out of scope, several of them close to a domain; 'followups' carry earlier turns, and the label is for the latest message in that conversation. The router is also tested on the 71 real FAQ questions in ingest/incoming/questions/questions.json (domain 'general' = other) and on every question in eval/demo_questions.json (rti) and eval/agri_questions.json (agriculture).
